_comment: Battle scene settings (Battle System v2: the Attack and Defense bars move on their own; tap one to act).
Each bar starts slow and speeds up to its top speed on a curve (the equipped gear sets both; with none:
starts at 15, top speed 200, reached after 1.8 s, on a bar 120 long). The two are scaled separately:
bar_slow_speed_scale: multiplies the slow start (1 = as the gear sets it; lower = even slower start).
bar_fast_speed_scale: multiplies the top speed it speeds up to (higher = faster after the slow start).
bar_cooldown_ms: after a tap, how long that bar waits (milliseconds) before it moves again.
Read when the game starts; without this file the game uses 1, 1 and 1500.
